about: Replay regression corpus (cortex plan T5.3, slot 193, 2026-10-21 +02:00). Every saved capture with its expected verdict file in expected/<name>.json. fixture:<dir> = tests/fixtures/<dir> (synthetic, committed). live:<dir> = $NERVE_CAPTURE_ROOT/<dir> (default /workspace/swarm/nerve-capture; read-only VPS captures, kept on the box, never committed: they hold real journal lines). Checked by tests/replay_corpus.rs and `cargo xtask replay-corpus`; re-bless with REPLAY_CORPUS_BLESS=1 only for an intended verdict change, and say why in the commit.
